Heroic bloodshed | Heroic bloodshed is a genre of Hong Kong action cinema revolving around stylized action sequences and dramatic themes such as brotherhood, duty, honour, redemption and violence. Baker defined the genre as "a Hong Kong action film that features a lot of gun play and gangsters rather than kung fu.  Lots of blood.  Lots of action."
